sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Repair the pressure-formula SPARQL constraint so zero loadPatchHeight or loadPatchLength is itself a violation. The current FILTER (?height != 0 && ?length != 0) suppresses the formula comparison and permits a zero denominator to pass. Retain the kN-to-MPa conversion and expected-result-scaled tolerance, but make the violation condition include ?height = 0 || ?length = 0 OR the tolerance-exceeding pressure difference.
